name: R5-S9
description: R5-S9 was an R5 unit manufactured by Industrial Automaton that served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. It was working in the power control room of the Senate Office Building on the planet Coruscant when the bounty hunter Cad Bane and a posse of bounty hunters entered looking to cut the power to the building before taking a group of senators hostage. Bane and his colleagues then destroyed R5-S9.
